sketch_notes: The sketches imply a largely static informational page with very limited JavaScript needs. Across both viewports, the only clearly interactive element is the header search form; the rest appears to be text content, tables, and links that can function without JS. There is no clear evidence of hamburger navigation, dropdowns, accordions, tabs, modals, sticky behavior, or progressive loading differences between mobile and desktop.
